content.text: [Slack DM huang_min Mon Jan 10 08:10 UTC 2026] I promise I revoked the key in the OpenAI dashboard right after the commit. You can mark it as done.
Cannot confirm — GitGuardian webhook shows the key as active as of 08:03 UTC. Please provide the OpenAI dashboard revocation timestamp so I can cross-reference.
[Slack DM huang_min Mon Jan 10 08:13 UTC 2026] OK I think I only generated a new key but didn't actually deactivate the old one. Let me check.
Please do not touch the key yet. We need to log the current state first before any changes.
[Slack DM huang_min Mon Jan 10 08:20 UTC 2026] I checked. The original key is still active in the OpenAI dashboard. I did NOT revoke it. I was wrong earlier. Sorry.
Understood. Documenting: Huang Min's initial revocation claim was incorrect. The OpenAI key remains active. We proceed with formal revocation procedure.
